name: Corner-Snap Mini Player
note: On release the player's position is projected along its measured velocity and springs to the nearest corner, keeping the throw's speed, while a sideways fling past an edge dismisses it behind an undo pill. Enlarging is a FLIP scale anchored at its corner, and arrow keys hop between corners.
html:
The Lantern ReviewMusic

Live review · Varga Hall Sessions

Night two: the strings arrive late, and nobody minds

PLPetra Lindqvist · 4 min read

The Late Trains came on at 21:40, forty minutes behind the posted time, because the string section was still crossing the river. Nobody in the hall seemed to mind. Ama Okafor spent the wait tuning a twelve-string at the lip of the stage, talking to the front row about ferries.

When the quartet finally filed in, still in their coats, the band dropped straight into “Low Bridge” without a count. It was the loosest version of the song I have heard, and the best.

The middle of the set belongs to the strings. On “Signal Box” the cellist, Ivo Brandt, takes the melody the guitar used to carry, and the whole room leans in a little.

Two nights remain. If you can only make one, go for the second half of the set and stand near the left speaker stack.
